title: Nancy
creator: CrossFit
description: Five rounds of a 400 m run and 15 overhead squats at 95/65 lb. Programmed since December 2004, it asks for control and balance overhead while the heart rate is high from the run. Scale the load so the overhead squats can be unbroken.
